comparability_requirements: trade vs broad AR/AP semantics remain distinct
same balance scope, currency, entity, and basis
revenue/COGS relation requires compatible flow period
design.currency_basis: same verified financial currency; no inferred FX conversion
design.daily_delta_use: only newly effective post-baseline validated change; preserve M3 cutoff lineage
directional_core_usage: compare inventory/receivable movement with compatible revenue evidence
state observed divergence without asserting its cause
design.entity_attribution_basis: same issuer, consolidation scope, statement basis, and attribution basis
forbidden_derivations: year-end to interim balance called YoY
DSO without average trade AR and compatible revenue
inventory days without average inventory and compatible COGS
missing working-capital data treated as negative
design.initial_analysis_use: eligible as absolute evidence when valid and material
message_usage: avoid generic working-capital deterioration when only one balance is known
design.missing_data_behavior: Unavailable and confidence-limiting only when the claim depends on it
design.monitoring_baseline_use: may enrich baseline; enrichment is not Daily Delta
period_basis: balance date vs prior-year comparable date
balance date vs prior year-end with explicit label

safe_derivations.formula: current point-in-time balance - compatible prior balance
safe_derivations.name: balance_absolute_delta

safe_derivations.formula: directional relation to prior-year comparable balance
safe_derivations.name: balance_yoy_relation

safe_derivations.formula: compare compatible balance and revenue directions
safe_derivations.name: balance_vs_revenue_relation

design.single_quarter_vs_cumulative_semantics: QTD, YTD, FY, TTM, and point-in-time remain distinct; no label-based guess
design.valuation_usage: context for denominator quality only; no multiple, price target, or valuation fact
design.warning_kill_condition_use: may support warning when material and contextual; no one-period automatic kill
